description: This file defines various protocols, typealiases, and extensions related to device services such as camera, screen recording, location, device status, photos, contacts, calendar, reminders, motion, and watch messaging. It specifies interface contracts for these functionalities in an iOS app context.

classes.name: CameraController
classes.description: Extension conforming CameraController to CameraServicing protocol for camera functionalities.

classes.name: ScreenRecordService
classes.description: Implementation conforming ScreenRecordService to ScreenRecordingServicing for screen recording functionalities.

classes.name: LocationService
classes.description: Implementation conforming LocationService to LocationServicing for location-related functionalities.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of available camera devices.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Asynchronously captures a photo with specified parameters.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Asynchronously records a video clip with specified parameters.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Starts screen recording with optional parameters.

methods.name: authorizationStatus
methods.description: Returns the current location authorization status.

methods.name: accuracyAuthorization
methods.description: Returns the current accuracy authorization.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Ensures location permission is granted for a given mode.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the current location asynchronously with specified parameters.

methods.name: startLocationUpdates
methods.description: Starts streaming location updates.

methods.name: stopLocationUpdates
methods.description: Stops streaming location updates.

methods.name: startMonitoringSignificantLocationChanges
methods.description: Begins monitoring significant location changes with a callback.

methods.name: stopMonitoringSignificantLocationChanges
methods.description: Stops monitoring significant location changes.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Retrieves device status asynchronously.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Retrieves device information synchronously.

methods.name: latest
methods.description: Fetches the latest photos based on parameters.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches contacts based on provided parameters.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds contacts based on provided parameters.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Fetches calendar events with specified parameters.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a calendar event.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists reminders based on given parameters.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a reminder.

methods.name: activities
methods.description: Fetches motion activities.

methods.name: pedometer
methods.description: Retrieves pedometer data.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Checks watch messaging support and pairing status.

methods.name: setReplyHandler
methods.description: Sets the handler for watch quick reply events.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification to the watch.
